🌍🇮🇳 INDIA’S MEDIATION MOMENT HAS ARRIVED
WELCOME, MEDIATION COUNCIL OF INDIA
THE WAIT IS OVER.
THE FOUNDATION IS LAID.
THE RESOLUTION ERA BEGINS.
After three years of anticipation following the Mediation Act, 2023, India has crossed a historic threshold.
By Gazette of India – Extraordinary, S.O. 4781(E), dated 27 August 2026, the Government of India has officially established the Mediation Council of India under Section 31(1) of the Mediation Act, 2023.
FROM “YET TO TAKE OFF” TO “FINALLY TAKING OFF.”
This is more than the creation of a regulator.
It is the beginning of a new mediation ecosystem for India.
A stronger foundation for professional standards, registration and recognition, training, accreditation, ethics and public confidence in mediation.
And the significance goes far beyond India.
🌏 INDIA CAN HELP SHAPE THE GLOBAL RESOLUTION MOVEMENT
In a world of increasingly complex commercial, family, community, institutional, technological and cross-border conflicts, we need more than mechanisms to fight disputes.
We need mechanisms to resolve them.
Dialogue over confrontation.
Collaboration over escalation.
Resolution over prolonged conflict.
Peace over unnecessary adversarialism.
At MedArb International, we have always believed that ADR must evolve beyond being merely an alternative to litigation.
ADR MUST BECOME A CULTURE.
A culture of dialogue.
A culture of prevention.
A culture of reconciliation.
A culture of responsible resolution.
FROM DISPUTE RESOLUTION TO THE RESOLUTION ECONOMY.
From families to boardrooms.
From communities to corporations.
From domestic disputes to cross-border conflicts.
From litigation dependency to dialogue-driven justice.
India—with its scale, diversity, legal heritage and technological strength—has an extraordinary opportunity to become a global hub for mediation, ODR and peaceful dispute resolution.
As President of MedArb International, I extend my warmest welcome and very best wishes to the Mediation Council of India on this landmark beginning.
The Council is now established.
The opportunity is immense.
The responsibility is ours.
The future is ours to build.
**THE REGULATOR IS HERE.
THE MEDIATORS ARE READY.
THE WORLD IS WATCHING.**
Let us create a future where resolution is not the last resort—but the first choice.
THE RESOLUTION ERA HAS BEGUN.
RESOLVE. RECONCILE. TRANSFORM.
— THILLAINAYAGAM SANKARAVEL
President – MedArb International
